audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors repeated across the whole page: (a) 'His Tongue Lash out-ranges your Inner Flame' — it does not, Tongue Lash is 900 and Inner Flame is 950; (b) Devour is called 'W Devour' in four places — Devour is his R, and W is Abyssal Dive. A third error: 'his R map roam' — Devour is not a roaming tool.
audit.why: The range claim inverts the single most important spacing fact in the lane and tells a 950-range poke champion she is out-ranged by a drain tank. The slot error would have a player watching the wrong button for the lethal follow-up.
audit.corrected: Range corrected in whys[1], spikes[1], early, phases[0].why and report[5]; Devour named as R in whys[4], spikes[2], early, mid, late and wants.foe[2]; the false R-roam replaced with the real An Acquired Taste three-stack stun mechanic.
sources: kit Tahm Kench Q range 900, P/Q stack text, R text

audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD, diffRating 4/10 and prose 'Favoured matchup' all disagree, against a 36.84% win rate.
audit.why: Sub-37% with a level chart Tahm Kench owns five of seven rows of is not a favoured lane at 4/10.
audit.corrected: diffRating 7.5/10 (diff stays HARD), carry threat 6/10, difficulty prose reworded, and the 'Free poke forever' TL;DR replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart on disk gave Karma levels 1 and 6 and gave Tahm Kench the first-item row; the packet says Skill / TK / TK / TK / TK / Skill / TK.
audit.why: Level 6 is his spike, not hers — Mantra was live at level 1 and the three-stack Tongue Lash stun into Devour arrives now. whys[5] already describes the first-item row as 'even at best', which is Skill, not Tahm Kench.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 5 flipped in both layers to match the packet, with the full-layer whys rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abyssal Dive was framed as 'his escape and re-engage' with no cooldown, and Tongue Lash's cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Tongue Lash at 7s is the button that actually punishes a step-up; Abyssal Dive at 21s is the all-in window.

edits.before: Tahm out-ranges you at Level 1 — his Tongue Lash (Q) pokes from past your Inner Flame range and slows you, so do not walk up to throw a basic Q he can answer for free. Your one real opening is opening with RQ Soulflare while Mantra is up, because that delayed Soulflare zone and slow is the only damage that out-paces his Thick Skin grey-health passive. Past that, every point of HP you chip off just refills as grey health he heals back, so trade for last-hits, not for kills. Above all, never get clipped by his three-stack Tongue Lash at melee range — a Tongue stun into W Devour is a free flash-or-die.
edits.after: Tahm out-sustains you at Level 1, but he does not out-range you — Inner Flame reaches 950 to Tongue Lash's 900, so poke from the edge and never walk up to a Q he answers for free. Your one real opening is RQ Soulflare while Mantra is up, because that delayed zone and slow is the only damage that out-paces his Thick Skin grey-health passive. Past that, every point of HP you chip off just refills as grey health he heals back, so trade for last-hits, not for kills. Above all, never get clipped by a third An Acquired Taste stack — that Tongue Lash stuns, and Devour (R) after it is a flash-or-die.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are normally your bullying peak, but it stalls here: your Inner Flame and RQ rotations chunk him and Thick Skin sponges it straight back, so you are spending mana to heal him. Keep Inspire's shield-and-speed and the Focused Resolve root in reserve for the moment he steps up to Tongue Lash you — that is the only trade you win, and landing it via Gathering Fire rebuilds your Mantra. At 6 his R gives him a map-wide roam threat and a three-stack Q stun that sets up his jungler, so do not overextend behind a poke advantage that is not real. Tax what plates you can with Inspire speed and accept you cannot solo-kill a drain tank.

edits.before: This is where it slips fully to him. Once Tahm stacks bruiser HP, your poke has no percent-HP component, so RQ and Inner Flame are a rounding error against his grey health and Thick Skin, and his Tongue Lash stun into W Devour deletes your thin frame in any skirmish. You have no late power spike of your own to answer his, so do not try to duel him — your job was to convert tempo before now. Roam, shield and speed your carries with Inspire and Mantra, and let your team trade objectives while you avoid ever standing alone in his Tongue Lash range.

notes: This was the worst matchup in my slice. Three separate mechanical errors ran through the content layer: Tongue Lash was said to out-range Inner Flame (it is 900 vs 950 — Karma out-ranges him), Devour was labelled 'W' four times when it is his R, and Devour was described as a map-wide roam tool it is not. The mirror had already flagged the range inversion. Tahm Kench's R cooldown reads 0 and range 25000 in the kit file — tooltip artifacts, so I stated neither.
